abstract: Core Astro knowledge plus hard-won gotchas: the CSS scoping model (and how it silently breaks layout-authored styles for slotted/client-injected content), the Vite dev-server proxy rewriting Host and breaking same-origin checks, IPv4/IPv6 dev-server bind splits, location.replace dropping URL hashes, page-script render timing races against async state loads, and canvas chart library sizing/theming pitfalls.
